More frequently 2. בְּטֶרֶם 39, with the same force: of past time, Gn 27:33 I ate of all בטרם תבא before thou camest, 37:18; 41:50 Ju 14:18 1 S 2:15 Je 1: 5; 47:1 Ez 16:5 7; ψ 90:2 Pr 8:25 (both with pf.); more often of pres. or fut., as Gn 27:4 בטרם אמות before I die (so 45:28, cf. ψ 39:14 Jb 10:2 1), Lv 14:36 Dt 31:21 1 S 9:13 2 K 2:9 Is
